opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn 2026 round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications are open to UK and international non‑profit organisations (and to individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for Research and Travel grants).
opportunities.summary: Grants support exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, research, publications and conferences related to sculpture.
